Leaf returns somber, soaked from the waist down, carrying four white water lilies in her arms. She brings them to the basin and one by one places each flower in the water, taking a moment to watch them float around the stone Mello. Finally, she brings the basin up to the top of the tree and places it gently in the crook of a branch facing the Château. She sits up on the branch, once again watching the flowers float and spin in the water. Having never been to a temple of the Wild Mother, she imagines that perhaps this is what one would be like. Small. Simple. Peaceful. 
Leaf climbs down into the tree for a moment and comes back up holding a few small items in her hands. First, she leans the holy symbol she got from Navar against the side of the basin, along with the last letter he'd left her on the sub. Next she opens a small box and in a similar fashion Leaf arranges the coral carved statue of Melora next to Ebuc's last letter, finally actually slipping on the ring of force resistance. She says the names again, this time with a small smile. "Calmation, Amara, Ebuc and Navar. Lost, not gone. Just like you were, Mello."
